english.note: Use this for the negative, nosy sense of being curious about other people’s business.

exampleSentences.english: Don't be so curious, always asking how much other people earn.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔好咁八卦，成日問人哋人工幾多。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baat3 gwaa3 seng4 jat6 man6 jan4 dei6 jan4 gung1 gei2 do1

english.note: Use this for someone who gossips or fuels interpersonal drama rather than for physical untidiness.

exampleSentences.english: They are really messy and always stir up arguments between people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢真係好八卦，成日搞到人哋鬧交。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 baat3 gwaa3 sing4 jat6 gaau2 dou3 jan4 dei6 naau6 gaau1
